items.title: Pay total claimed amount to creditor
items.quote: Sie werden aufgefordert, innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung entweder den Gesamtbetrag samt weiterer Zinsen an die Antragstellerin zu überweisen oder dem Gericht zu erklären, ob und in welcher Höhe Sie widersprechen.
items.computation: Service (Zustellung) occurred on 20.11.2026 (Friday), per the envelope note 'Zugestellt am 20.11.2026 – Einwurf in den Hausbriefkasten'. Under §187(1) BGB the day of the triggering event is not counted, so the two-week period runs from 21.11.2026. Under §188(2) BGB a period stated in weeks ends on the day in the last week that corresponds by name to the day of the event, i.e. two weeks after the Friday of service: 20.11.2026 + 14 days = 04.12.2026 (Friday). 04.12.2026 is a Friday and not a public holiday in Hessen, so no shift under §193 BGB is needed. Due date: 04.12.2026.

items.title: File Widerspruch with the court instead of paying
items.quote: Sie werden aufgefordert, innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung entweder den Gesamtbetrag samt weiterer Zinsen an die Antragstellerin zu überweisen oder dem Gericht zu erklären, ob und in welcher Höhe Sie widersprechen.
items.computation: Same delivery date (20.11.2026, Friday) and same statutory period calculation as the payment obligation above (§187(1), §188(2) BGB): the two-week period for lodging Widerspruch with the Amtsgericht ends on 04.12.2026 (Friday), a non-holiday weekday in Hessen, so the deadline is not shifted.

warnings: The letter does not state the creditor's bank account details for the payment; verify the correct IBAN/recipient from the official court-issued payment slip or enclosure before transferring any money, rather than from any other source.
If no Widerspruch is filed in time, the creditor may obtain a Vollstreckungsbescheid (enforcement order) allowing enforced collection, so missing the 04.12.2026 deadline has serious consequences.
